Bamme devarim amurim beyisrael baal avera vehaomed berisho veshone bo tamid kegon roe behema dakka sheppakru begezel vehem holchim beivvaltan. aval yisrael baal averot sheeno omed berisho tamid ella ose averot lahanaat atzmo kegon ochel nevelot leteavon mitzva lehatztzilo veasur laamod al damo:

Kol hahoreg bishgaga gole mimmedina sheharag bah leare miklat umitzvat ase lehageloto shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 25)</small> "veyashav bah ad mot hakkohen haggadl". vehuzharu bet din shello yikchu kofer min harotzeach bishgaga kede leshev beiro shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 32)</small> "velo tikchu chofer lanus el ir miklato":

En harotzeach bishgaga gole ella im ken met hanneherag miyyad. aval im chaval bo bishgaga af al pi sheamaduhu lemita vechala umet eno gole shemma hu kerev et mitat atzmo o haruach nichnesa bachabbura vaharagathu. afillu shachat bo kol shene hassimanim veamad meat eno gole al yado. lefichach im lo pirkes kelal o sheshshechato bemakom sheen haruach menashshevet bo kegon bayit satum shel shayish hare ze gole. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Yisrael sheharag bishgaga et haeved (o et ger toshav) gole. vechen haeved sheharag bishgaga et yisrael o et ger toshav vechen ger toshav sheharag et ger toshav o et haeved bishgaga gole shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 15)</small> "livne yisrael velagger velattoshav betocham":

Ger toshav sheharag et yisrael bishgaga af al pi shehu shagag hare ze neherag. adam muad leolam. vechen ger toshav sheharag ger toshav mippene sheala al dato shemmuttar lehargo hare ze karov lemezid veneherag alav hoil venitkavven lehargo. veakkum sheharag et haakkum bishgaga en are miklat koltot oto shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 15)</small> "livne yisrael":

Habben sheharag et aviv bishgaga gole vechen haav sheharag et beno gole al yado. bamme devarim amurim kesheharago shello bishat limmud. o shehaya melammedo ummanut acheret sheeno tzarich lah. aval im yisser beno kede lelammedo tora o chachma o ummanut umet patur:

Vechen harav hammakke et talmido o sheliach bet din shehikka et baal din hannimna millavo laddin vehemito bishgaga patur min haggalut shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 5)</small> "lachtov etzim". ledivre harshut. yatza haav hammakke et beno veharav harode et talmido usheliach bet din shehare shaggu vehargu bishat asot hammitzvot:

Battechilla echad shogeg veechad mezid makdimin leare miklat uvet din shel otah hair sheharag bah sholchin umeviin oto mishsham vedanin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 12)</small> "veshalchu zikne iro velakchu oto mishsham". mi shennitchayyev mita memitin oto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 12)</small> "venatnu oto beyad goel haddam". mi shenniftar potrim oto shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 25)</small> "vehitztzilu haeda et harotzeach miyyad goel haddam". mi shennitchayyev galut machazirin oto limkomo shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 25)</small> "veheshivu oto haeda el ir miklato":
Keshemmeshivin oto mosrin lo shene talmide chachamim shemma yahargenu goel haddam badderech. veomer lahem al tinhagu bo minhag shofche damim, beshogeg ba maase leyado:
Rotzeach bishgaga sheharago goel haddam chutz litchum ir miklato patur shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 6)</small> "velo en mishpat mavet":

Echad hahorgo badderech kodem sheyyikkanes leir miklat o sheharago bachazirato im hashshenayim sheshshomrin oto. nichnas leir miklato veyatza chutz litchumah bezadon hare ze hittir atzmo lemita ureshut legoel haddam lehargo. veim harago kol adam en chayyavin alav shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 27)</small> "en lo dam":
Yatza chutz litchum ir miklato bishgaga kol hahorgo ben goel haddam ben shear adam gole al yado. harago betoch techum ir miklato afillu goel haddam hare ze neherag alav:

Hammizbeach kolet shenneemar behoreg bezadon <small>(Shemot 21 14)</small> "meim mizbechi tikkachennu lamut" mikkelal shehahoreg bishgaga eno neherag bammizbeach lefichach hahoreg bishgaga ukelato mizbeach vaharago sham goel haddam hare ze neherag alav kemi sheharago betoch ir miklat:

En kolet ella gaggo shel mizbeach bet haolamim bilvad veen kolet ella kohen vaavoda beyado. aval zar o kohen sheeno oved beshaa shenneherag o shehaya oved velo haya al gaggo shel mizbeach ella samuch lo o ochez bekarnotav eno niklat:

Vechen mi shekkelato hammizbeach en mannichin oto sham ella mosrin [lo] shomrin umaglin oto leir miklato. bamme devarim amurim bimchuyyav galut. aval mi sheppachad min hammelech shello yahargennu bedin hammalchut o mibbet din shello yaharguhu behoraat shaa uvarach lammizbeach venismach lo vaafillu haya zar hare ze nitztzal veen lokchin oto meim hammizbeach lamut leolam. ella im ken nitchayyev mitat bet din beedut gemura vehateraa kishar kol haruge bet din tamid:

Shelosha hem hahorgim belo kavvana: 
Yesh horeg bishgaga vehaalama gemura vezehu shenneemar bo <small>(Shemot 21 13)</small> "vaasher lo tzada". vedino sheyyigle leare miklat veyinnatzel kemo shebbearnu: 
Veyesh horeg vetihye hashshegaga karov leones vehu sheyyeera bemitat ze meora pele sheeno matzuy berov meorot bene adam. vedino shehu patur min haggalut. veim harago goel haddam neherag alav: 
Veyesh horeg bishgaga vetihye hashshegaga kerova lezadon vehu sheyyihye baddavar kemo peshia. o shehaya lo lehizzaher velo nizhar. vedino sheeno gole mippene sheavono chamur en galut mechapperet lo veen are miklat koltot oto sheenan koltot ella hamechuyyav galut bilvad. lefichach im metzao goel haddam bechol makom vaharago patur: 
Uma yaase ze. yeshev veyishmor atzmo miggoel haddam. vechen kol haratzchanim shehargu beed echad o belo hateraa vechayyotze bahen im haragan goel haddam en lahem damim. lo yihyu ellu chamurim mehahoreg belo kavvana: 
Ketzad. hazzorek even lirshut harabbim veharga o hassoter katlo lirshut harabbim venafla even vehemita. ben shessetaro bayyom ben shessetaro ballayla hare ze karov lemezid veeno niklat mippene shezzo peshiut hi shehare haya lo leayyen veachar kach yizrok o yistor: 
Setaro laashpa ballayla im harabbim metzuyin bah hare ze karov lemezid veeno niklat veim en harabbim metzuyin bah kelal hare ze karov leones ufatur min haggalut: 
Hayta haashpa asuya lehippanot bah ballayla veenah asuya lehippanot bah bayyom venikra adam veyashav sham venafla alav even bishat setira umet hare ze gole. veim achar shennafla haeven ba ze veyashav venafla alav umet hare ze patur min haggalut: 
Vechen hazzorek et haeven veachar sheyyatzat miyyado hotzi halla et rosho vekibbelah patur miggalut shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 5)</small> "umatza et reehu" perat lemamtzi atzmo: 
Hassone sheharag bishgaga eno niklat shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 23)</small> "vehu lo oyev lo" chezkato shehu karov lemezid. vee zehu sone ze shello dibber immo shelosha yamim mippene haeva. vechen im nichnas lekeren zavit vehemito sham bishgaga o sheddechafo begufo o nitkavven lizrok shetayim vezarak arba. o sheala al dato shemmuttar laharog. o shennitkavven laharog et ze veharag et ze afillu nitkavven laharog akkum o behema venimtza yisrael hare kol ellu kerovin lemezid veenan niklatin: 
Hannichnas lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vaharago baal habbayit bishgaga patur min haggalut shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 5)</small> "vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar" ma yaar sheyyesh reshut lanneherag lehikkanes lesham af kol kayyotze bo. lefichach hannichnas lachanut hannaggar shello birshut venitteza bekaat vetafcha lo al panav umet patur miggalut. veim nichnas birshut hare ze gole: 
Mi shehaya dole et hechavit lehaalotah laggag. venifsak hachevel venafla al chavero vaharagathu. o shehaya ole bassullam venafal al chavero vaharago. patur min haggalut. shezze kemo anus hu. sheen ze davar hakkarov lihyot berov haittim ella kemo pele hu. aval im haya meshalshel et hechavit venafla al chavero vaharagathu. haya yored bassullam venafal al chavero. haya meaggel bemagela venafla al chavero vaharagathu. gole. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 23)</small> "vayyappel alav vayyamot" sheyyippol derech nefila. shehare derech nefila matzuy berov haittim lehazzik vedavar karov hu lihyot. shehare teva hakkaved lered lematta bimhera. vehoil velo zerez atzmo vetikken maasav yafe bishat yerida yigle. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Katztzav shehaya mekatztzev vehigbiah yado bakkofitz laachorav vehecheziro lishbor haetzem kederech sheosin hakkatztzavim. kol sheyyamut baholacha shehi hahagbaha millefanav virida meacharav eno gole alav. vechol sheyyamut bachazara shehi aliyya meacharav virida millefanav gole. ze hakkelal kol shebbederech yeridato gole shello bederech yeridato eno gole. vaafillu birida shehi tzorech aliyya eno gole: 
Ketzad. haya ole bassullam venishmeta sheliva mittachat raglav venafla vehemita patur min haggalut. vechen hammitkavven lizrok betzad ze vehalcha lah letzad acher o shehayta lo even munnachat becheko velo hikkir bah meolam veamad venafla vehemita. vechen hassuma sheharag bishgaga. kol ellu peturin min haggalut mippene shehen kerovin leones: 
Hayta even becheko vehikkir bah ushechachah veamad venafla vehemita gole shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 11)</small> "bishgaga" mikkelal shehayta lo yedia. nishmat habbarzel min haetz hammitbakkea eno gole mippene sheen ze ba mikkocho ella mikkoach kocho venimtza kemo ones. vechen hazzorek even letamar lehappil temarim venaflu min hattemarim al tinok vaharaguhu patur mippene shennaflu mikkoach kocho. vechen kol kayyotze baze mishshear hassibbot:

Talmid sheggala leare miklat maglin rabbo immo shenneemar vachay ase lo kede sheyyichye vechayye baale chachma umevakkesheha belo talmud tora kemita chashuvin. vechen harav sheggala maglin yeshivato immo: 
Eved sheggala leir miklat en rabbo chayyav lezuno umaase yadav lerabbo. aval ishsha sheggalta leir miklat balah chayyav lezunah. veeno yachol lomar lah tzei maase yadayich limzonotayich ella im ken hayu maspikin lah: 
Rotzeach shennigmar dino lehageloto umet kodem sheyyigle molichin atzmotav lesham. verotzeach shemmet beir miklato kovrin oto sham. uveet sheyyamut hakkohen haggadol molichin atzmot harotzeach mishsham lekivre avotav: 
Shear haleviyyim hashshochnim beare miklat kesheyyamut echad mehen eno nikbar beir velo betoch hattechum. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 3)</small> "umigreshehem yihyu livhemtam velirchusham ulechol chayyatam". lechayyim nittanu velo likvura: 
Rotzeach sheharag bishgaga beir miklato. gole bah mishshechuna lishchuna veeno yotze min hair. vechen levi sheharag bimdinato gole limdina acheret meare haleviyyim. lefi shekkullan koltot kemo sheyyitbaer. veim harag chutz meare haleviyyim uvarach leiro hare ze kolto: 
Ir miklat sherubbah ratzchanim enah koletet. shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 20 4)</small> "vedibber beazne zikne hair hahi et devarav" velo sheshshavin divrehem lidvarav. vechen ir sheen bah zekenim enah koletet shenneemar zikne hair hahi: 
Rotzeach sheggala leir miklat veratzu anshe hair lechabbedo. yomar lahem rotzeach ani. amru lo af al pi chen yekabbel mehen: 
Haggole eno yotze meir miklato leolam. vaafillu lidvar mitzva o leedut ben edut mamon ben edut nefashot. vaafillu lehatztzil nefesh beeduto o lehatztzil miyyad haoved kochavim o miyyad hannahar o miyyad haddeleka umin hammappolet. vaafillu kol yisrael tzerichin litshuato keyoav ben tzeruya eno yotze mishsham leolam ad mot hakkohen haggadol. veim yatza hittir atzmo lemita kemo shebbearnu: 
Echad kohen gadol hammashuach beshemen hammishcha. veechad hamerubbe bivgadim. veechad hakkohen haggadol haoved. veechad hakkohen sheavar. kol echad mearbatan shemmet machzir et harotzeach. aval meshuach milchama eno machzir mippene shehu kechohen hedyot: 
Rotzeach shennigmar dino liglot velo haya sham kohen gadol. vehahoreg kohen gadol velo haya sham kohen gadol acher. vechohen gadol sheharag velo haya sham kohen gadol acher. hare ellu golin veenan yotzin meir miklat leolam: 
Nigmar dino legalut veachar kach met hakkohen haggadol kodem sheyyigle harotzeach. hare ze patur min haggalut. veim ad shello nigmar dino met hakkohen haggadol uminnu kohen acher tachtav veachar kach nigmar dino hare ze chozer bemitato shel sheni shennigmar dino befanav: 
Nigmar dino venimtza hakkohen haggadol ben gerusha o ben chalutza. batla kehunna ucheillu nigmar dino belo kohen gadol veeno yotze mishsham leolam: 
Rotzeach sheshshav leiro achar mot hakkohen haggadol. hare hu kishar kol adam. veim harago goel haddam neherag alav shekkevar nitkapper lo begaluto: 
Af al pi shennitkapper lo eno chozer lasserara shehaya bah leolam. ella hare hu murad miggedullato kol yamav hoil uvaa takkala zo haggedola al yado: 
Af al pi shehachovel beaviv bezadon chayyav mitat bet din kemo hahoreg shear adam. im chaval beaviv o beimmo bishgaga eno chayyav galut. shello chiyyeva tora galut ella [lehoreg] nefesh adam bishgaga bilvad kemo shebbearnu:

Mitzvat ase lehaferish are miklat shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 2)</small> "shalosh arim tavdil lach". veen are miklat nohagot ella beeretz yisrael: 
Veshesh arim hayu. shalosh hivdil moshe rabbenu beever hayyarden. veshalosh hivdil yehoshua beeretz kenaan: 
En achat meare miklat koletet ad sheyyuvdelu kullan. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 13)</small> "shesh are miklat tihyena lachem". vehodianu moshe rabbenu sheen shalosh shebbeever hayyarden koltot ad sheyyuvdelu shalosh shebbeeretz kenaan. velamma hivdilan amar hoil uvaa mitzva leyadi akayyemenna: 
Bime hammelech hammashiach mosifin shalosh acherot al ellu hashshesh. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 9)</small> "veyasafta lecha od shalosh arim al hashshalosh haelle". vehechan mosifin otan beare hakkeni vehakkenizzi vehakkadmoni shennichrat leavraham avinu berit alehen vaadayin lo nichbeshu vaalehen neemar battora <small>(Devarim 19 8)</small> "veim yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulcha": 
Vechayyavin bet din lechavven hadderachim leare miklat letakkenam uleharchivan. umesirin mehen kol michshol vechol takkala. veen mannichin badderech lo tel velo gay velo nahar. ella osin alav gesher kede shello leakkev et habboreach lesham. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 3)</small> "tachin lecha hadderech". verochav derech are miklat en pachot mishsheloshim ushetayim ammot. umiklat miklat haya katuv al parashat derachim kede sheyyakkiru haratzchanim veyifnu lesham: 
Bachamishsha asar baadar bechol shana bet din motziin sheluchim letakken hadderachim. vechol makom shemmetzauhu shennitkalkel metakkenim oto. uvet din shennitrashshelu bedavar ze maale alehen hakkatuv keillu shafchu damim: 
Vechen moshchin ben kol ir veir meare miklat bitchillat haferashatan ad sheyyihyu meshullashot beshave. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 3)</small> "tachin lecha hadderech": 
Are miklat en osin otan lo ayarot gedolot velo kerakkim gedolim velo ketannim ella ayarot benoniyyot. veen moshivin otan ella bimkom shevakim uvimkom hammayim. veim en sham mayim machnisin letochan mayim. veen moshivin otan ella bimkom uchlusin. nitmaatu uchlusehen mosifin alehen. nitmaatu diyyurehen machnisin letochan kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. veen porsin betochan metzudot veen mafshilin betochan chavalim kede shello yihye regel goel haddam metzuya sham: 
Kol are haleviyyim koltot vechol achat mehen ir miklat hi. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 6)</small> "vaalehem tittenu arbaim ushetayim ir" <small>(Bamidbar la 7)</small> "kol hearim asher tittenu lalviyyim arbaim ushemone ir". hikkishan hakkatuv kullan zo lazo liklot: 
Uma hefresh yesh ben are miklat shehuvdelu lemiklat uven shear are haleviyyim. sheare miklat koltot ben ledaat ben shello ledaat hoil venichnas bahen niklat. ushear are haleviyyim enan koltot ella ledaat. verotzeach haddar beare miklat eno noten sechar beto. vehaddar bishar are haleviyyim noten sachar levaal habbayit: 
Kol ir hakkoletet techumah kolet kamoha. ilan sheomed betoch techum are miklat venofo note chutz lattechum mishsheyyaggia tachat hannof niklat. haya omed chutz lattechum venofo note letoch hattechum mishsheyyaggia leikkaro niklat vehahorgo sham neherag alav. veaf al pi shehattechum kolet en harotzeach dar bo shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 25)</small> "veyashav bah" bah velo bitchumah:

Harug shennimtza nofel laaretz velo noda mi hikkahu mannichin oto bimkomo. veyotzin chamishsha zekenim mibbet din haggadol shebbirushalayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 2)</small> "veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha" umoddin mimmennu el hearim shessevivot hechalal. afillu nimtza betzad ir zo shehaddavar yadua bevadday shehi hakkerova mitzva limdod: 
Achar shemmoddin venoda hair hakkerova kovrin et hanneherag bimkomo vechozrin zikne yerushalayim limkoman. uvet din shel otah hair meviin eglat bakar mishshel anshe otah hair umoridin otah el nachal sheshshotef bechazka vezehu <small>(Devarim 21 4)</small> "etan" haamur battora: 
Veorfin otah sham bekofitz meachareha. uvet din shel otah hair im kol zekeneha afillu hem mea kullan rochatzin et yedehen sham bimkom arifatah veomrim sham betoch hannachal bilshon hakkodesh <small>(Devarim 21 7)</small> "yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze veenenu lo rau". kelomar shello ba leyadenu hanneherag hazze ufetarnuhu belo mezonot velo reinuhu ufetarnuhu belo levaya. vehakkohanim omrim bilshon hakkodesh <small>(Devarim 21 8)</small> "kapper leammecha yisrael". veholchin lahen. vehakkadosh baruch hu mechapper al haddam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 8)</small> "venikkapper lahem haddam": 
Keshemmoddin min hechalal medakdekin bammidda veen mekadderin bah. veen moddin ella leir sheyyesh bah bet din shel esrim ushelosha. veen moddin lirushalayim sheyyerushalayim en mevia egla arufa lefi shello nitchalleka lishvatim veneemar <small>(Devarim 21 1)</small> "baadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lerishtah": 
Nimtza karov lirushalayim o leir sheen bah bet din mannichin otah umoddin el shear haayarot hassemuchot lo. nimtza samuch lassefar o leir sheyyesh bah akkum en moddin kol ikkar shehare ze bechezkat sheharaguhu akkum: 
En hair hakkerova mevia ella bizman shemminyan harov shebbah kemo minyan hair harchoka mimmenna. aval im hayu ellu shebbarchoka merubbin al anshe hakkerova mimmenna holchin achar harov vehamerubbin meviin haegla: 
Af al pi sheholchin achar harov min hattora veholchin achar hakkarov harov adif: 
Nimtza hanneherag mechuvvan ben shete ayarot veanshe zo keanshe zo beshave yaviu egla achat beshuttafut. veyatnu veyomru. im zo hi hakkerova hare hi shellahen veellu yittenu lahem chelkam mattana. veim ellu hem hakkerovim hare hu shellahen veellu yittenu lahen chelkam mattana. lefi shei efshar letzamtzem vaafillu bide adam: 
Mehechan moddin. mechatmo. nimtza gufo bemakom echad verosho bemakom acher molichin hagguf etzel harosh vekovrim oto bimkomo. vechen kol met mitzva molichin gufo etzel rosho venikbar bimkomo: 
Nimtzeu metim rabbim ze betzad ze. moddin mechatmo shel kol echad veechad mehen. veim hayta ir achat kerova lechullam mevia egla achat al kullan. nimtzeu ze al gabbe ze moddin min haelyon kemot shehen munnachin: 
Neemar <small>(Devarim 21 1)</small> "ki yimmatze chalal" lo chanuk velo mefarper sheen ze nikra chalal. <small>(Devarim 21 1)</small> "baadama" lo tamun begal. <small>(Devarim 21 1)</small> "nofel" lo taluy beilan. <small>(Devarim 21 1)</small> "bassade" lo tzaf al pene hammayim. <small>(Devarim 21 1)</small> "lo noda mi hikkahu" ha im noda lo hayu orfin: 
Afillu raa hahoreg ed echad afillu eved o ishsha o pasul leedut baavera lo hayu orfin. lefichach mishsherabbu haratzchanim begaluy batla egla arufa: 
Ed echad omer raiti et hahoreg veed echad hichchisho veamar lo lo raita hayu orfin. bamme devarim amurim keshebbau shenehem keachat. aval im amar echad ani raiti et hahoreg hare ze neeman kishnayim leinyan ze. veim ba achar kach ed echad vehichchisho veamar lo lo raita en mashgichin al divre haacharon veen orfin: 
Bau shenayim achar sheheid haechad vehichchishuhu veamru lo lo raita hare hen kishte eduyyot hammachchishot zo et zo veorfin. ishsha omeret raiti et hahoreg veishsha acheret machcheshet otah veomeret lo rait hayu orfin ben shebbau shetehen keachat ben shebbau zo achar zo. shenayim omrim rainu veechad omer lahen lo reitem en orfin. echad omer raiti ushenayim omrim lo lo raita hayu orfin: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu shelashtan kesherim o pesulim. aval im amar ed echad raiti hahoreg ushete nashim o shene pesulim omrim lo lo raita en orfin: 
Shete nashim o shene pesulim omrim rainu hahoreg veed echad machchisham veomer lo reitem orfim. sheafilu mea nashim o mea pesulim veed echad machchish et kullan hare ellu keish echad veed echad: 
Shalosh nashim o shelosha pesulim omrim rainu hahoreg vearba nashim o arbaa pesulim omrim lo reitem orfin. ze hakkelal bifsulin [hallech] achar rov hamminyan bechol makom:
En din egla arufa noheg ella baaretz yisrael vechen beever hayyarden:

Egla arufa bat shete shanim o pachot. aval im hayta bat shete shanim veyom echad pesula. veen hammumin poslin veaf al pi chen im hayta terefa pesula. <small>(Devarim 21 8)</small> "kappara" neemar bah kekadashim:

Kol haavodot poslot et haegla kemo shepposlin befara adumma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 3)</small> "asher lo ubbad bah". velamma neemar ol achar shenneemar asher lo ubbad bah shehu kolel haol im shear avodot. shehaol posel ben bishat melacha ben shello bishat melacha kevan shemmashcha beol tefach nifsela af al pi shello charash bah velo asa bah melacha. ushear avodot en poslin ella ad sheat melacha:

Kol melacha shehi letzarkah kegon peras tallito aleha mippene hazzevuvim eno poslah. vechol shehi shello letzarkah kegon shepperas tallito aleha lenosah pesula. vechen kol kayyotze baze kemo shebbearnu behilchot para adumma:

En orfin et haegla ella bayyom lefi shenneemar bah <small>(Devarim 21 8)</small> "kappara" kekadashim. vechol hayyom kasher laarifatah. veen orfin shete eglot keachat sheen osin mitzvot chavilot chavilot:
Egla arufa asura bahanaa venikberet bimkom arifatah umishshettered lannachal teaser bahanaa af al pi sheadayin lo neerfa. veim meta o nishchata achar yeridatah hare zo asura bahanaa vetikkaver:

Nimtzeu haedim zommin hare zo mutteret bahanaa. ketzad. kegon sheamar ed echad ani raiti et hahoreg uvau shenayim vehichchishuhu veamru lo lo raita. vehifrishu et haegla vehoriduha lannachal learfah al pihem. veachar kach huzammu hashshenayim. hare zo mutteret bahanaa:

Nimtza hahoreg ad shello tearef haegla tetze vetire baeder. nimtza achar shenneerfa tikkaver bimkomah. sheal hassafek baa mittechillatah kippera sefekah vehalcha lah. veaf al pi shennimtza harotzeach achar arifatah hare ze yehareg shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 9)</small> "veatta tevaer haddam hannaki":

Hannachal shenneerfa bo haegla asur bizria vaavoda leolam. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 4)</small> "asher lo yeaved bo velo yizzarea". vechol haoved sham avoda begufah shel karka kegon shecharash o chafar o zara o nata vechayyotze baellu hare ze loke. umuttar lisrok sham pishtan ulenakker sham avanim shezze kemi shearag sham beged o tefaro sheenah melacha beguf hakkarka. lechach neemar lo yeaved velo yizzarea ma zeria begufah shel karka af kol haavoda shenneesra sham enah ella begufah shel karka:
Anshe ir kerova shennitacharu velo heviu egla arufa. kofin otan umeviin vaafillu leachar kamma shanim. shechayyave egla arufa sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim chayyavim lehavi achar yom hakkippurim:

Mitzvat ase laasot adam maake legaggo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 8)</small> "veasita maake legaggecha". vehu sheyyihye bet dira. aval bet haotzarot uvet habbakar vechayyotze bahen eno zakuk lo. vechol bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot patur min hammaake: 
Bayit shel shene shuttafin chayyavin bemaake shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 8)</small> "ki yippol hannofel mimmennu" lo tala ella benofel. im ken lamma neemar <small>(Devarim 22 8)</small> "gaggecha" lemaet batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot lefi sheenan asuyim ledira. hayta reshut harabbim gevoha miggaggo eno zakuk lemaake shenneemar ki yippol hannofel mimmennu velo letocho: 
Gova hammaake en pachot measara tefachim kede shello yippol mimmennu hannofel. vetzarich lihyot hamechitztza chazaka kede sheyyishshaen adam aleha velo tippol. vechol hammeniach gaggo belo maake bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 8)</small> "velo tasim damim bevetecha". veen lokin al lav ze mippene sheen bo maase: 
Echad haggag veechad kol davar sheyyesh bo sakkana verauy sheyyikkashel bah adam veyamut. kegon shehayta lo beer o bor bachatzero ben sheyyesh bo mayim ben sheen bo mayim chayyav laasot chulya gevoha asara tefachim. o laasot lah kissuy kede shello yippol bah adam veyamut. vechen kol michshol sheyyesh bo sakkanat nefashot mitzvat ase lahasiro ulehishshamer mimmennu ulehizzaher baddavar yafe yafe. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 9)</small> "hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha". veim lo hesir veheniach hammichsholot hammeviin lide sakkana bittel mitzvat ase veavar b<small>(Devarim 22 8)</small> "lo tasim damim": 
Harebe devarim asru chachamim mippene sheyyesh bahem sakkanat nefashot. vechol haover alehen veomer hareni mesakken beatzmi uma laacherim alay bechach o eni makpid bechach makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Veellu hen. lo yanniach adam piv al hassilon hamekalleach veyishte. velo yishte ballayla min hanneharot umin haagammim shemma yivla aluka vehu eno roe. velo yishte mayim megullim shemma shata mehen nachash vechayyotze bo mizzochale afar veyamut: 
Veellu hen hammashkin haasurin mishshum gilluy. hammayim. vehayyayin. vaafillu mazug vaafillu hitchil taamo lehishtannot lechometz. vehechalav. vehaddevash. vehatztzir. aval shear kol hammashkin en makpidin al gilluyan sheen baale eres shotin mehen: 
Hashshum shennitrassek vaavattiach shennechtach venitgalla asur. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. yayin mevushshal veyayin toses en bahen mishshum gilluy. vetoses hu hayyayin mishsheat derichato ad shelosha yamim. veyayin o mayim o chalav shehayu chammin kol zeman shehahevel ole mehen vechen mashkin shehaya hammashke yored millemala letochan tippa achar tippa vehu sheyyihye tored veyored kol ellu en bahen mishshum gilluy shezzochale afar mityarim mibbibua hammashke umin hahevel veen shotin mimmennu: 
Me kevashin umi shelakot ume turemusin en bahen mishshum gilluy. mayim sheshshara bahen kevashin ushelakot veturemusin im nishtanna taman en bahem mishshum gilluy. veim en bahem noten taam asurin. vechen mayim shehediach bahen perishim vedarmusekin lachole asurin mishshum gilluy: 
Yayin shennitchabber bo devarim chaddin kefilpelin o devarim marim keafsantin ad shennishtanna taamam en bo mishshum gilluy. vehu haddin bishar hammashkin: 
Kol hammashkin haasurin mishshum gilluy shennitgallu ben bayyom ben ballayla asurin vaafillu haya betziddan adam yashen en emat yashen al hazzochalin. vechamma yishhu veyeasru. kede sheyyetze harachash mittachat ozen keli veyishte veyachzor limkomo: 
Shiur hammayim sheyyeasru im nitgallu kede sheyyihye hassam nikkar bahen umazzik. aval im hayu hammayim merubbin kede shettovad bahen hammara hare ellu muttarin ben bechelim ben bekarkaot. vechen haddin bishar hammashkin: 
Mayan hammoshech kol shehu en bo mishshum gilluy. lagin megulle shehinnicho beshidda teva umigdal o battik shello o babbor afillu amok mea amma o bemigdal gavoah mea amma o bitraklin meyuppe umesuyyad hare ze asur. badak et hatteva o et hammigdal veachar kach hinnicho hare ze muttar. veim haya bahen nekev asur. kamma yehe bannekev. kede shettikkanes etzba ketanna shel katan: 
Chavit shennitgalleta af al pi sheshshatu mimmennu tisha velo metu lo yishte asiri. maase haya veamru sheshshata asiri umet mippene sheeres hannachash shaka lematta. veyesh sam chamat zochale afar sheole vetzaf lemala veyesh sam shehi nitlet beemtza hammashke. lefichach hakkol asur vaafillu sinneno bemisnenet. vechen avattiach shennitgalla af al pi sheachlu mimmennu tisha velo metu lo yochal asiri: 
Mayim shennitgallu lo yishpechem lirshut harabbim velo yerabbetz bahem et habbayit velo yegabbel bahen et hattit velo yirchatz bahen panav yadav veraglav velo yashke mehen lo behemto velo behemat chavero. aval mashke otan lechatul: 
Issa shennillosha bemayim megullin afillu hi shel teruma tissaref vaafillu neefet happat asura:

Behema chayya o of shenneshachan hannachash vechayyotze bo o sheachlu sam hammemit haadam kodem sheyyishtanne begufan hare ellu asurim mishshum sakkanat nefashot. lefichach behema chayya veof shennimtzeu chatuche raglayim af al pi shehen muttarin mishshum terefa hare ellu asurin mishshum sakkana shemma echad mizzochale afar neshachan ad sheyyibbadku. ketzad bodkan. tzole otan betannur. im lo nitchattech habbasar velo nishtanna mishshear hatztzali hare ellu muttarin: 
Vechen nikkure teenim vaanavim vehakkishshuim vehaddilluin vehaavattichin vehammelaffonot afillu hayu gedolim beyoter ben telushin ben mechubbarin vaafillu hayu betoch hakkeli kol sheyyesh bo lecha venimtza nashuch asur shemma nachash vechayyotze bo neshacho. vaafillu raa tzippor o achbar yoshev umenakker hare ellu asurin shemma bimkom nekev nikkav: 
Teena o enav shennittal haoketz shellahen en bahem mishshum gilluy. lefichach ochel adam teenim vaanavim ballayla veeno choshesh. teena nekura sheyyavsha venaaset gerogeret utemara nekura sheyyavsha shetehen muttarot: 
Asur leadam litten maot o dinarim letoch piv shemma yesh alehen rok yavesh shel mukke shechin o metzorain o zea. shekkol zeat adam sam hammavet chutz mizzeat happanim: 
Vechen lo yitten adam pas yado tachat shechyo shemma naga beyado bimtzora o besam ra shehayyadayim askaniyyot. velo yitten hattavshil tachat hammitta af al pi shehu osek bisuda shemma yippol bo davar hammazzik vehu eno roehu: 
Vechen lo yinotz hassakkin betoch haetrog o betoch hatztzenon shemma yippol adam al chuddah veyamut. vechen asur laadam laavor tachat kir natuy o al gesher raua o likkanes lechurba. vechen kol kayyotze beellu mishshear hassakkanot asur laavor bimkoman: 
Vechen asur lihudi lehityached im haakkum mippene shehen chashudim al shefichut damim. velo yitlavve immahen badderech. paga akkum badderech machziro limino. hayu olin bemaale o yordim birida lo yihye yisrael lematta veakkum lemala ella yisrael lemala veakkum lematta shemma yippol alav lahamito. veal yashoach lefanav shemma yarotz et gulgalto: 
Im shealo lean atta holech yarchiv lo et hadderech kederech shehirchiv yaakov leesav shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 33 14)</small> "ad asher avo el adoni seira": 
Asur likkach refua min haakkum ella im ken nityaashu mimmennu sheyyichye. veasur lehitrappeot min haeppikoros veaf al pi shennityaashu mimmennu shemma yimmashchu acharav. umuttar likkach refua min haakkum livhema o lemakka shebbagguf mibbachutz kegon melugema uretiyya. veim hayta makka shel sakkana asur likkach mimmennu. vechol makka shemmechallelin aleha et hashshabbat en mitrappein mehem: 
Umuttar lishol lerofe akkum veyomar lo sam peloni yafe lecha vechach vechach taase aval lo yikkach mimmennu: 
Veasur lehistapper mehen birshut hayyachid shemma yahargennu. im haya adam chashuv muttar mippene shemmityare lehargo. veim dimma leakkum shehu adam chashuv kede sheyyefached mimmennu velo yahargennu hare ze muttar lehistapper mimmennu: 
Asur limkor leakkum kol kele hammilchama veen mashchizin lahem et hazzayin veen mochrin lahen lo sakkin velo kolarin velo kevalim [shel barzel] velo shalshelaot shel barzel hindua velo dubbim vaarayot velo kol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim. aval mochrin lahen terisin sheenan ella lehagen: 
Ucheshem sheasru limkor leakkum kach asru limkor leyisrael shemmocher leakkum. umuttar limkor kele zayin lechayil shel bene hammedina mippene shehen meginnin al yisrael: 
Kol sheasur limkor leakkum asur limkor leyisrael shehu listim mippene shennimtza machazik yede ovre avera umachshilo. vechen kol hammachshil ivver bedavar vehissio etza sheenah hogenet o shechizzek yede ovre avera shehu ivver veeno roe derech haemet mippene taavat libbo hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl". habba littol mimmecha etza ten lo etza hahogenet lo: 
Veasur lehassi etza tova leakkum o leeved rasha. vaafillu lehassio etza sheyyaase devar mitzva vehu omed berisho asur. velo nitnassa daniyyel ella al shehissi etza linvuchadnetztzar litten tzedaka shenneemar lahen <small>(Daniel 4 24)</small> "malka milki yishpar alach":

Mi sheppaga bachavero badderech uvehemto rovetzet tachat massaa ben shehaya aleha massa harauy lah ben shehaya aleha yoter mimmassaah hare ze mitzva lifrok mealeha vezo mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 5)</small> "azov taazov immo": 
Velo yifrok veyannichennu nivhal veyelech ella yakim immo veyachzor veyiton massao aleha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 4)</small> "hakem takim immo" zo mitzvat ase acheret. veim hinnicho nivhal velo parak velo taan bittel mitzvat ase veavar al mitzvat lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 4)</small> "lo tire et chamor achicha": 
Haya kohen vehabbehema rovetzet bevet hakkevarot eno mittamme lah keshem sheeno mittamme leheshshev aveda. vechen im haya zaken sheen darko liton velifrok hoil veenah lefi kevodo patur: 
Ze hakkelal kol sheillu hayta shello haya toen uforek hare ze chayyav liton velifrok beshel chavero. veim haya chasid veose lifnim mishshurat haddin afillu haya hannasi haggadol veraa behemat chavero rovetzet tachat massaa shel teven o kanim vechayyotze bahen porek vetoen immo: 
Parak vetaan vechazra venafla chayyav liton velifrok paam acheret afillu mea peamim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 5)</small> "azov taazov" <small>(Devarim 22 4)</small> "hakem takim immo". lefichach tzarich lehiddaddot immo ad parsa ella im ken omer lo baal hammassa eni tzarich lecha: 
Meematay yitchayyev lifrok veliton immo. mishsheyyirehu reiyya shehi kifgia shehare neemar <small>(Shemot 23 5)</small> "ki tire" veneemar <small>(Shemot 23 4)</small> "ki tifga". vechamma. shiaru chachamim mishsheyyihye benehem matayim veshishshim veshesh amma ushene shelishe amma shehu echad mishshiva umechetza bemil. haya rachok mimmennu yeter mizze eno zakuk lo: 
Mitzva min hattora lifrok immo bechinnam. aval liton alav hare zo mitzva venotel secharo. vechen beshaa shemmedadde immo ad parsa yesh lo sachar: 
Matza behemat chavero revutza af al pi sheen habbealim immah mitzva lifrok mealeha veliton aleha shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 5)</small> "azov taazov" <small>(Devarim 22 4)</small> "hakem takim" mikkol makom. im ken lamma neemar immo sheim haya baal habbehema sham vehalach veyashav lo veamar laze sheppaga bo hoil vealecha mitzva im ratzita lifrok levaddecha perok hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 5)</small> "immo". veim haya baal habbehema zaken o chole chayyav liton velifrok levaddo: 
Behemat haakkum vehammassa shel yisrael im haya haakkum mechammer acher behemto eno zakuk lah. veim lav chayyav lifrok veliton mishshum tzaar yisrael. vechen im hayta habbehema shel yisrael vehammassoy shel akkum chayyav lifrok veliton mishshum tzaar yisrael aval behemat haakkum umassao eno chayyav lehittappel bahen ella mishshum eva: 
Chammarim sheraglav shel echad mehen reuot enan rashshain chaverav lehakedim velaavor mealav. nafal rashshain laavor mealav: 
Haya echad taun veechad rochev udechakan hadderech. maavirin et harochev mippene hattaun. echad taun veechad rekan maavirin et harekan mippene hattaun. echad rachuv veechad rekan maavirin et harekan mippene harachuv. shenehen teunin shenehen rochvin shenehen rekanin osin peshara benehen: 
Vechen shete sefinot haovrot ufogot zo bazo im ovrot shetehen bevat achat tovot veim bazo achar zo ovrot. vechen shene gemallim haolim bemaale gavoah ufagu ze baze im ovrin shenehem bevat achat noflin veim baze achar ze olin. ketzad hen osin. teuna vesheenah teuna tiddache sheenah teuna mippene hatteuna. kerova urechoka tiddache kerova mippene sheenah kerova. shetehen rechokot o kerovot o teunot hoil vechullan bedochak echad hattel peshara benehen vehen maalot sachar ze laze. uvaze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "betzedek tishpot amitecha": 
Happogea bishnayim echad rovetz tachat massao veechad parak mealav velo matza mi sheyyiton immo. mitzva lifrok battechilla mishshum tzaar baale chayyim veachar kach toen. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu shenehem sonim o ohavim. aval im haya echad sone veechad ohev mitzva liton im hassone techilla kede lachof et yitzro hara: 
Hassone shenneemar battora lo meummot haolam hu ella miyyisrael. veheach yihye leyisrael sone miyyisrael vehakkatuv omer <small>(Vayikra 19 17)</small> "lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha". amru chachamim kegon sheraahu levaddo sheavar avera vehitra bo velo chazar hare ze mitzva lesano ad sheyyaase teshuva veyashuv merisho. veaf al pi sheadayin lo asa teshuva im metzao nivhal bemassao mitzva liton velifrok immo velo yannichennu note lamut shemma yishhe bishvil mamono veyavo lide sakkana. vehattora hikpida al nafshot yisrael. ben reshaim ben tzaddikim. meachar shehem nilvim el Adonai umaaminim beikkar haddat. shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 33 11)</small> "emor alehem chay ani neum Adonai elohim im echpotz bemot harasha ki im beshuv rasha middarko vechaya".
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 1: Hannezirut hu neder mikkelal nidre issar shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 2)</small> "ki yiddor neder nazir" vegomer. umitzvat ase sheyyegaddel sear rosho shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 5)</small> "gaddel pera sear rosho". veim gilleach bime nizro over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 5)</small> "taar lo yaavor al rosho". vechen asur lehittame lammetim o leechol devarim sheasaran hakkatuv alav <small>(Bamidbar 6 4)</small> "miggefen hayyayin" <small>(Bamidbar 6 4)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 6 8)</small> "kol yeme nizro":

Avar vegilleach o nitma o achal miggefen hayyayin hare ze loke shetayim. achat mishshum <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro" shekkolel kol hannedarim. veachat mishshum davar sheavar alav middevarim sheasurin issur meyuchad al hannazir:

Nadar benazir vekiyyem nidro kemitzvato hare ze ose shalosh mitzvot ase. haachat <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase" vahare asa. vehashsheniyya <small>(Bamidbar 6 5)</small> "gaddel pera sear rosho" vahare giddel. vehashshelishit tiglachto im havaat karbenotav shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 18)</small> "vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed" vegomer:
Haomer lo eppater min haolam ad sheeheye nazir hare ze nazir miyyad shemma yamut atta. veim echer neziruto hare ze over beval <small>(Devarim 23 22)</small> "teacher leshallemo" veen lokin al lav ze:

En omrin binzirut ad sheyyotzi bisfatav davar shemmashmao etzel kol haam kainyan shebbelibbo. ella kevan sheggamar belibbo vehotzi bisfatav devarim sheinyanam sheyyihye nazir af al pi shehen inyanot rechokot veaf al pi sheen bemashmaan leshon nezirut hare hu nazir:

Ketzad. hare shehaya nazir over lefanav veamar ehye hare ze nazir hoil uvelibbo haya sheyyihye kemo ze veaf al pi shello peresh veamar ehye kemo ze. vechen im achaz bisaro veamar ehye nae o ehe mechalkel o aha mesalsel o sheamar hareni mesalsel o hareni mechalkel o hare alay leshalleach pera hare ze nazir vehu sheyyigmor belibbo lehazzir:
Amar hare alay tzipporim af al pi shehaya nazir over lefanav veaf al pi shehaya belibbo lehazzir eno nazir vahare ze kemi shello hotzi bisfatav kelum:
Kol kinnuye nezirut kinzirut. ketzad. mekomot haillegim shemmeshannin et haddibbur veamar sham hareni nazik naziach paziach hare ze nazir:

Haomer hareni nazir min hachartzannim bilvad o min hazzaggim bilvad o hareni nazir min hattiglachat o hareni nazir min hattuma bilvad hare ze nazir gamur vechol dikduke nezirut alav veaf al pi shello haya belibbo lehazzir ella middavar ze bilvad hoil vedavar shennazar mimmennu asur al hannezirim hare ze nazir gamur:
Aval haomer hareni nazir min haggerogarot o min haddevela vechayyotze bahen hare ze asur bahen veeno nazir:

Mazgu lo kos shel yayin venatnu lo lishtot veamar hareni nazir mimmennu hare ze nazir gamur. veim haya mar nefesh o koes o mitabbel vehayu mevakkeshin mimmennu sheyyishte kede leshakkeach amalo veamar hare ze nazir mimmennu hare ze asur beoto hakkos bilvad veeno nazir. shello nitkavven ze ella shello yishte kos ze:

Vechen shikkor shennatnu lo kos kede lerauoto veamar hare ze nazir mimmennu hare ze asur beoto hakkos bilvad veeno chayyav binzirut shello nitkavven ze ella shello yeshakkeru oto yoter midday. veim higgia leshichruto shel lot en devarav kelum veeno chayyav al kol avera sheyyaase shemmishshehiggia leshichruto shel lot eno ben chiyyuv:

Haomer hareni nazir al menat sheeheye shote yayin o mittamme lammetim o megalleach seari hare ze nazir veasur bechullam. mippene shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora vechol hammatne al hakkatuv battora tenao batel:

Nadar benazir veamar lo hayiti yodea shehannazir asur beyayin o betuma o betiglachat veillu hayiti yodea ken lo hayiti noder hare ze nazir vechayyav bechullam. shehare hu haya yodea sheasar atzmo beechad mishshelosha minin uchevar bearnu sheafillu lo nadar ella meechad mehem asur bechullan:

Amar yodea hayiti shehannazir asur bechol ellu aval haya bedati shemmuttar li lishtot ani hayyayin mippene sheeni yachol lichyot belo yayin o mippene sheani kover et hammetim hare ze eno nazir. mippene sheellu bichlal nidre shegagot sheenam tzerichin sheela lechacham kemo shebbearnu:
Haomer hare yadi nezira hare ragli nezira lo amar kelum. hare roshi nazir kevedi nezira hare ze nazir. ze hakkelal kol evar sheim yinnatel min hachay yamut im amar hare hu nazir hare ze nazir:

Haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben. im nolad lo ben zachar hare ze nazir. aval im nolda lo bat o tumtum o anderoginus en ze nazir. amar hareni nazir kesheyyihye li valad afillu nolad lo bat o tumtum veanderoginus hare ze nazir. hippila ishto eno nazir. chazra venitabbera veyalda hare ze nazir:
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 2: Hannoder benazir beshogeg o beones o shennadar lezarez chavero o derech havay hare ze patur kishar nedarim. umi shennadar benazir venicham al nidro hare ze nishal lechacham umattir lo neziruto kederech shemmattirin shear hannedarim:

Mi shennadar benazir vehalach lehavi karbenotav shennazar al daat sheyyeviem bimlot yeme nizro. metzaan shennignevu o nigneva behema mehen. im ad shello nigneva habbehema nazar hare ze nazir. veim achar shennigneva o sheavda o shemmeta nazar eno nazir shezze nazar betaut:
Hammatpis binzirut hare ze nazir kemo shebbearnu bedin kol hammatpis beneder:

Haya nazir over lefanav veamar hareni kaze hare ze nazir. nadar chavero benazir veamar hu pi kefiv miyyayin o sheamar seari kisaro millehiggazez hare ze nazir. vechen im shama veamar vaani betoch kede dibbur [veshama shelishi betoch kede dibbur] shel sheni veamar vaani vaafillu hen mea kullan nezirin:
Haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben vachavero amar vaani hare chavero nazir miyyad:

Haomer lachavero hareni nazir kesheyyihye lecha ben veshama chavero veamar vaani en ze nazir. shello nitkavven ze haacharon ella lomar sheani ohev sheyyihye lecha ben kemo ze shehare hu bosh mimmennu:
Haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye lifloni ben veshama chavero veamar vaani. hare ze safek shemma lo nitkavven ella lihyot nazir kemoto o lomar sheani ohev oto kemotcha. usefek nezirut lehakel:

Shenayim shehayu mehallechim badderech verau echad ba kenegdan veamar echad min hashshenayim ze haholech kenegdenu shimon hu. veamar chavero reuven hu. veamar ze hareni nazir im yihye reuven. veamar haacher hareni nazir im yihye shimon. higgia alehem vahare hu reuven hare ze nazir. veim haya shimon hare chavero nazir kemo shennadru. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lo higgia alehem ella chazar laachorav venelam meenehem velo yadu mi hu en echad mehen nazir:
Vechen haomer hareni nazir im yihye bichri ze mea kor vehalach lemoddo umetzao shennignav o sheavad eno nazir. vechen kol kayyotze baze. shessafek nezirut lehakel:

Hayu mehallechin badderech verau et hakkevi merachok veamar echad mehem hareni nazir shezze chayya. veamar acher hareni nazir shezze behema. veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ze chayya. veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ze behema. veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ze lo chayya velo behema. veamar acher hareni nazir shezze behema vechayya hare kullam nezirim. mippene shehakkevi yesh bo derachim shave bahen lechayya veyesh bo derachim shave bahen livhema veyesh bo derachim shave lechayya velivhema veyesh bo derachim sheeno shave lo livhema velo lechayya. vehu haddin im rau anderoginus venechleku bo im hu ish o ishsha venadru al derech shennadru ellu bichvi hare kullam nezirim. shehaanderoginus yesh bo derachim shave bahen leish. uderachim shave bahen leishsha. uderachim sheeno shave bahen lo leish velo leishsha. uderachim shehen shavin leish uleishsha:

Vechol hadderachim haellu beinyene hammitzvot velo betivo vetoladto. vechen darche hakkevi beinyene hammitzvot lo betivo vetoladto. ketzad. damo taun kissuy kechayya vechelbo asur kivhema. vahare hu kilayim im habbehema vechen im hachayya keillu enah chayya velo behema. vetaun shechita kivhema vechayya. veyesh bo derachim acherim vechol echad mehen yitbaer bimkomo. vechen anderoginus mittamme beloven kaanashim. umittamme beodem kenashim. veeno nimkar beeved ivri lo kaanashim velo kenashim. vehahorgo neherag alav kaanashim uchenashim. veyesh bo dinim acherim vechol echad yikkatev bimkomo:

Vechen im rau anashim baim kenegdam mehem pikchim umehem sumim veamar echad hareni nazir sheellu pikchin. veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ellu pikchin. veamar acher hare ani nazir sheellu sumin. veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ellu sumin. veamar acher hareni nazir sheellu pikchin vesumin. veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ellu lo pikchin velo sumin. hare kullam nezirim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Katan shehiggia leonat nedarim venadar benazir hare ze nazir umevi karbenotav. veaf al pi sheadayin lo hevi shete searot kishar hannedarim. vehaish maddir et beno katan benazir af al pi shello ba leonat nedarim. veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala hu veeno noheg bishar nedarim:

Ketzad. haav sheamar livno hakkatan hare atta nazir. o sheamar beni peloni nazir o hare ze nazir. veshatak habben. hare ze nazir vechayyav haav linhog bo kol dikduke nezirut veim nitma mevi karban tuma. uchesheyyashlim neziruto mevi karban tohora kishar hannezirim haggedolim:

Lo ratza habben umicha bedavar ze o shemmichu kerovav o sheggilleach searo o sheggillechuhu kerovav shehare naasa maase sheggilla dato shello ratza hu o kerovav binzirut zo hare ze eno nazir. vead matay yesh lo lehaddiro ad sheyyagdil veyease ish:
Haakkum en lahen nezirut. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 2)</small> "dabber el bene yisrael":
Nashim vaavadim yesh lahen nezirut. vehaav o habbaal mefer nezirut haishsha im ratza kishar hannedarim. aval haeved yesh lerabbo lachof oto lishtot ulehittame lammetim veim lo kafa oto noheg nezirut:

Nadar haeved shear nedarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh o shemmeakkevin et hammelacha o sheheerich. en rabbo tzarich lechuppo mippene sheen nafsho kenuya lo velo yachul alav neder. lema haddavar dome leoser perot acherim alehem. aval im en sham innuy velo davar shemmeakkev melacha eno yachol lechuppo. nadar avdo binzirut veamar lo mufar lecha yatza lecherut vechayyav lehashelim neziruto. shehaeved kofin oto veen meferin lo. veim hefer yatza lecherut:

Eved shennadar binzirut uvarach o shehalach merabbo hare ze asur lishtot yayin kede sheyyitztaer veyachzor lirshut rabbo. nazar vehishlim neziruto vegilleach velo yedao rabbo veachar kach yatza lecherut hare ze yatza yede nidro. aval im nadar velo gilleach veyatza lecherut lo yatza yede nidro. nitma veachar kach yatza lecherut mone mishshaa shennitma:
Nezirut noheget bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit. lefichach mi shennadar benazir bazzeman hazze hare ze nazir leolam. sheen lanu bayit kede sheyyavi karbenotav bimlot yeme nizro:

En hannezirut noheget ella beeretz yisrael. umi shennazar bechutza laaretz konsin oto umechayyevin oto laalot leeretz yisrael velihyot nazir beeretz yisrael keminyan hayyamim shennazar. lefichach mi shennadar bazzeman hazze bechutza laaretz kofin oto laalot leeretz yisrael velihyot noheg sham nezirut ad sheyyamut o ad sheyyibbane hammikdash veyavi karbenotav bimlot yeme nizro:

Vechol zeman shehu bechutza laaretz hare ze asur lishtot yayin ulehittame lammetim ulegalleach vechol dikduke nezirut alav veaf al pi sheen yamim ellu olin lo. veim avar veshata o gilleach o naga bemet vechayyotze bingia loke:
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 3:
Setam nezirut sheloshim yom. ketzad. mi sheamar hareni nazir en pachot mishsheloshim yom. vaafillu amar hareni nazir nezirut gedola ad meod harebe hare ze nazir sheloshim yom. shehare lo peresh zeman: 
Peresh zeman pachot mishsheloshim kegon sheamar hareni nazir yom echad o asara yamim o esrim yom hare ze nazir sheloshim yom sheen nezirut pechuta mishsheloshim yom. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala: 
Peresh zeman yoter mishsheloshim yom kegon sheamar echad usheloshim yom o arbaim o mea yom o mea shana hare ze nazir kizman shepperesh lo pachot velo yoter: 
Haomer hareni nazir shaa achat hare ze nazir sheloshim yom. amar hareni nazir sheloshim yom veshaa achat hare ze nazir echad usheloshim yom sheen nozrin shaot: 
Haomer hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni. im lo hechezik badderech hare ze nazir sheloshim yom bilvad. shello nitkavven ze ella linzirut gedola vahare lo peresh zeman. veim hechezik badderech im haya mehallech pachot mishsheloshim yom hare ze nazir sheloshim yom. veim haya yoter mishsheloshim yom hare ze nazir nezirut achat keminyan hayyamim: 
Mi sheamar hareni nazir shete nezirut o shalosh o arba hare ze nazir kamminyan sheamar kol nezirut mehen sheloshim yom. uvesof kol sheloshim usheloshim megalleach umevi karbenotav umatchil limnot nezirut sheniyya. afillu amar hareni nazir mea elef neziriyyot shei efshar sheyyichye kazzeman hazze hare ze mone achat achar achat ad sheyyamut o ad sheyyashlim minyan nezirutav: 
Haomer hareni nazir keminyan yemot hashshana. mone nezirutav keminyan yemot hashshana. im peresh shenat hachamma mone shelosh meot veshishshim vechamesh nezirut kol achat mehen sheloshim yom. veim peresh shenat levana mone shelosh meot arba vachamishshim nezirut. veim setam mone shelosh meot vearba vachamishshim nezirut shehare bearnu shekkol hannedarim holchin achar leshon bene adam. verov shene hachamma shelosh meot vachamishsha veshishshim yom monin lah. verov shene hallevana shelosh meot vearba vachamishshim yom monin lah. veen korin kol haam shana setam ella lishnat hallevana: 
Haomer hareni nazir achat umechetza hare ze nazir shete nezirut. amar hareni nazir veyom echad o sheamar hareni nazir veshaa achat hare ze nazir shete nezirut. amar hareni nazir veachat hare ze nazir shetayim. hareni nazir veachat veod hare ze nazir shalosh nezirut. hareni nazir veachat veod veshuv hare ze nazir arba nezirut. hareni nazir sheloshim yom veyom echad hare ze nazir nezirut achat shel sheloshim veechad yom: 
Mi shehayu shete kitte edim meidin oto. ellu meidin shennazar shetayim veellu meidin shennazar chamesh. hare ze nazir shetayim shebbichlal chamesh shetayim vahare kullan meidim bishtayim: 
Mi shennazar shete nezirut ben shennadar shetehen bevat achat ben shennadar zo achar zo. kegon sheamar hareni nazir yom hareni nazir yom umana et harishona vehifrish karban. veachar kach nishal al harishona vehittir nidro. alta lo rishona bashsheniyya umevi ze hakkarban veniftar. vaafillu hevi kapparato vaafillu gilleach searo veachar kach nishal aleha alta lo rishona bashsheniyya. shehare en hashsheniyya chala ella leachar harishona veharishona kevan shehittirah keillu enah meikkarah: 
Mi sheamar hareni nazir leolam o hareni nazir kol yeme chayyay hare ze nazir leolam. veim amar hareni nazir elef shana hare ze nazir lizman katzuv. veaf al pi shei efshar sheyyichye haadam elef shana: 
Vma ben nezir olam lenazir lizman katzuv. shehannazir lizman asur legalleach ad sof yeme neziro shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 5)</small> "kol yeme neder nizro taar lo yaavor al rosho ad melot hayyamim". unezir olam im hichbid searo mekel betaar mishshenem asar chodesh ad shenem asar chodesh. umevi karbano shalosh behemot kesheyyegalleach shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 14 26)</small> "vayhi mikketz yamim layyamim asher yegalleach ki chaved alav vegillecho". veavshalom nezir olam haya. vedavar ze halacha hi mippi hakkabbala. unezir olam shennitma hare ze mevi karban tuma umegalleach tiglachat tuma kemo nazir lizman katzuv: 
Shimshon lo haya nazir gamur. shehare lo nadar benazir ella hammalach hifrisho min hattuma. vechetzad haya dino. haya asur beyayin veasur betiglachat umuttar lehittame lammetim. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala: 
Lefichach mi sheamar hareni nazir keshimshon hare ze nazir min hattiglachat umin hayyayin leolam. veeno megalleach kol shenem asar chodesh kishar nezire olam. umuttar lehittame lammetim. veim amar lo nitkavvanti ella leish acher sheshshemo shimshon eno nazir. umi shennadar nazir keshimshon eno yachol lehishshael al nidro shennezirut shimshon leolam hayta: 
Haomer hareni keshimshon keven manoach. kevaal delila. kemi sheakar daltot azza. kemi shennikkeru pelishtim et enav. hare ze nazir kinzirut shimshon. veaf al pi sheefshar shennaasu maasim ellu leish acher: 
Shemuel haramati nezir olam haya. lefichach haomer hareni kishmuel haramati. keven channa. keven elkana. kemi sheshshissef et agag baggilgal. vechayyotze beellu. hare ze nezir olam. veen omrin shemma leish acher shemmaasav kaelle nitkavven: 
Haomer hareni nazir melo habbayit o melo hakkuppa. bodkin oto im amar lo haya bedati sheeheye nazir kol yamay velo nitkavvanti ella lehaarich zeman hannezirut zeman merubbe hare ze nazir sheloshim yom bilvad. veim amar setam nadarti roim et hakkuppa keillu hi melea chardal veyihye nazir kol yamav. veyesh lo legalleach mishshenem asar chodesh lishnem asar chodesh veyavi karbenotav kishar nezire olam: 
Haomer hareni nazir kisar roshi. o kaafar haaretz. o kechol hayyam. hare ze kemi sheamar hare nezirut alay keminyan sear roshi o keminyan afar haaretz o keminyan chol hayyam. lefichach yegalleach kol sheloshim yom veyatchil limnot nezirut sheniyya sheloshim yom vigalleach vechen ad sheyyamut. uvechol tiglachat vetiglachat eno shote yayin velo mittamme lammetim veim shata o nitma afillu beyom hattiglachat hare ze loke: 
Haomer hareni nazir im ochal kikkar zo. hareni nazir im ochalenna. hareni nazir im ochalenna. vaachalah. hare ze chayyav binzirut kamminyan sheamar umone achat achar achat kol achat mehen sheloshim umegalleach besof kol sheloshim umevi karbano:
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 4:
Haomer hareni nazir hare ze megalleach tiglachat tohora yom echad usheloshim. veim gilleach beyom sheloshim yatza. amar hareni nazir sheloshim yom eno megalleach ella beyom echad usheloshim: 
Mi shennazar shete neziruyyot megalleach et harishona beyom echad usheloshim. veet hashsheniyya beyom echad veshishshim. veim gilleach et harishona yom sheloshim megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim. veim gilleach yom tisha vachamishshim yatza. sheyyom sheloshim ole lo af leminyan nezirut sheniyya: 
Homer hareni nazir venazir kesheyyihye li ben. vehitchil nezirut shello veachar kach nolad lo ben. mashlim et shello veachar kach mone et shel beno. amar hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben vahareni nazir kach vechach yom. vehitchil binzirut shello veachar kach nolad lo ben. posek nezirut shello umone et shel beno veachar kach chozer umashlim et shello vahare shetehen kinzirut achat. lefichach im nitma betoch nezirut shel beno soter hakkol. nitma achar nezirut beno keshehitchil lehashelim neziruto eno soter ella ad nezirut beno. uvechamma yamim mashlim et shello. im nishar minneziruto keshennolad habben sheloshim o yoter mone nezirut beno umashlim hayyamim shennisharu minneziruto. veim nisharu minneziruto pachot mishsheloshim mone sheloshim achar nezirut beno. sheen ben tiglachat letiglachat pachot mishsheloshim yom: 
Ketzad. haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben vahareni nazir mea yom. vehitchil binzirut shello venolad lo ben. im nishar min hammea shennadar sheloshim yom o yeter keshennolad habben lo hifsid kelum. shehare posek nezirut shello umatchil umone shel beno umegalleach umevi karbenotav umashlim hashsheloshim o yeter shennisharu minneziruto umegalleach linziruto. veim nishar min hammea pachot mishsheloshim soter ad shivim: 
Ketzad. nolad habben beyom shemonim mone shel beno umashlim et shel beno umegalleach. umatchil limnot meachar hattiglachat sheloshim yom venimtza mafsid mikkodem havvalad asara yamim shehem miyyom shivim ad havvalad. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haomer hareni nazir leachar esrim yom. vechazar veamar hareni nazir meatta mea yom. mone esrim yom ufosek umatchil limnot sheloshim shehi hannezirut shennadar leachar esrim. veachar hashsheloshim megalleach tiglachat tohora umevi karbenotav vechozer umone shemonim yom kede lehashelim hammea shennadar bassof umegalleach umevi karbenotav: 
Amar hareni nazir leachar esrim yom vahareni nazir meatta. mone sheloshim yom umegalleach tiglachat tohora vechozer umone sheloshim yom acherim vehi hannezirut shennadar leachar esrim. sheim tomar mone esrim ufosek mone sheloshim umegalleach nisharu minnezirut shehitchil bah asara yom bilvad. veen ben tiglachat tohora letiglachat tohora leolam pachot mishsheloshim yom: 
Amar hareni nazir leachar esrim yom vechazar veamar hareni nezir olam meatta lo chala alav nezirut shennadar barishona: 
Vechen im amar hareni nezir shimshon leachar esrim yom. vechazar veamar hareni nazir meatta. eno megalleach linzirut zo shennadar baacharona: 
Mi sheamar hare ani nazir yom echad lifne mitati. hare ze asur lishtot yayin ulehittame ulegalleach leolam: 
Haomer hareni nazir bayyom shebben david ba bo. im bechol nadar hare ze asur leolam. veim beshabbat o beyom tov nadar otah shabbat o oto yom tov muttar. mikkan veelach asur leolam. shehaddavar safek im yavo beshabbat o beyom tov o lo yavo. vehoil vehu safek bayyom shennadar lo chala alav nezirut shessefek nezirut lehakel. mikkan veelach chala alav nezirut. veshabbat habbaa shehi safek enah mafkaat nezirut shechala alav: 
Nazir sheshshalmu yeme neziruto velo gilleach tiglachat tohora hare ze asur legalleach velishtot yayin ulehittame lemetim keshehaya mikkodem vechol dikduke nezirut alav. veim gilleach o shata yayin o nitma loke: 
Mi shennadar benazir vedimma sheeno neder vehaya noheg hetter benidro veshata yayin. uleachar zeman shaal lechacham vehorahu shehu neder veshehu chayyav binzirut hare ze mone mishshaa shennadar. umiddivre sofrim sheyyinhog issur kayyamim shennahag bahen hetter: 
Ketzad. hare shennadar sheloshim yom venahag hetter benidro asara yamim venahag issur esrim yom. uleachar hashsheloshim shaal lechacham veasar lo. hare ze mone asara yamim miyyom sheshshaal keneged haasara shennahag bahen hetter. veim shata o gilleach o nitma baaseret yamim haellu makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Bamme devarim amurim binzirut muetet. aval binzirut merubba dayyo sheyyinhog sheloshim yom binzirut af al pi sheavar al neziruto hamerubba kol yamav. veim lo nahag issur beatzmo en nizkakin lo kelal: 
Kol bet din shennizkakin laze vechayyotze bo umodiin leellu shemmezalzelin bindarim sheen chayyavin min hattora. o sheyyoru lahen lehakel o sheyyiftechu lahen petach. menaddin oto bet din hahedyot: 
Haishsha shennadra binzirut veshalmu yeme hannezirut vehevia karbenoteha venishchata achat min habbehemot venizrak damah veachar kach shama balah af al pi sheadayin lo gillecha eno yachol lehafer. veim kodem zerika hare ze yafer. bamme devarim amurim betiglachat tohora. aval betiglachat tuma yafer af al pi shekkarvu hakkarbanot shel tiglachat tuma. mippene shehi adayin tzericha limnot nezirut acheret:
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 5: Shelosha minin asurin lenazir. hattuma. vehattiglachat. vehayyotze min haggefen. ben peri ben pesolet peri. aval hashshechar shel temarim o shel gerogarot vechayyotze bahen muttar lenazir. v <small>(Bamidbar 6 3)</small> "shechar" ze shenneesar alav battora hu hashshechar shel taarovet hayyayin:

Hayyotze min haggefen ketzad. nazir sheachal kezayit min happeri shehu anavim lachim o yeveshim o boser. o sheachal kezayit mippesolet happeri shehi hazzaggin vehem hakkelippa hachitzona. o hachartzannim vehem hazzaggin happenimin shezzorim otan hare ze loke. vechen im shata reviit yayin o achal kezayit miyyayin karush shehu happeri o shata reviit chometz shehu pesolet happeri hare ze loke. aval healin vehallulavim ume gefanim vehassemadar hare ellu muttarin lenazir sheenan lo peri velo pesolet peri ella min haetz hen nechshavin:

Kol issure gefen mitztarfin ze im ze. ketzad. hare shetztzeref anavim lachim im yeveshim o im boser vechartzan vezag veachal min hattaarovet kezayit loke. vechen im achlam ze achar ze ad sheachal min hakkol kezayit loke. vechen im shata reviit taarovet yayin vechometz loke:

Davar hammuttar eno mitztaref ledavar haasur benazir. ketzad. yayin shennitarev bidvash af al pi shettaam hakkol taam yayin veshata min hattaarovet. vechen hatztzimmukin shedderasan im haggerogarot vetaam hakkol taam tzimmukin veachal min hattaarovet eno loke. ad sheyyihye middavar haasur battaarovet kezayit bichde shalosh betzim veachal keshalosh betzim. kishar haissurin hashshavim bechol adam kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot:

Vechen im shara pitto beyayin vehaya harviit yayin bichde peras min happat veachal kede peras shennimtza sheachal reviit yayin hare ze loke. veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 6 3)</small> "vechol mishrat anavim". leesor davar shennitarev bo hayyayin vetamo ketaam hayyayin vehu sheyyihye taamo umammasho kishar issure maachalot:
Nitarev yayin vechayyotze bo bidvash veen sham taam yayin hare ze muttar lenazir. lo yihye ze chamur mechelev vedam:
Haya bo taam yayin veen sham reviit bichde achilat peras hare ze asur middivre sofrim kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot. umakkin oto im achal makkat mardut:

Nazir sheachal kezayit anavim uchezayit chartzan uchezayit zag uchezayit tzimmukim veshata reviit yayin vaafillu sachat eshkol veshata mimmennu reviit hare ze loke chamesh malkiyyot. shekkol echad mehen belav echad hu. veloke malkut shishshit mishshum <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro" shehu shave bechol hannedarim. vechen im achal kezayit zag o kezayit anavim loke shetayim achat mishshum zag o mishshum anavim veachat mishshum lo yachel devaro. vehu haddin lenazir sheggilleach o nitma shehu loke shetayim. achat al haissur hameyuchad bo veachat al haissur hashshave bechol hannedarim shehu lo yachel devaro:

Nazir sheshshata reviit yayin ureviit chometz eno loke ella achat sheeno chayyav al hayyayin bifne atzmo veal hachometz bifne atzmo. sheen katuv yayin lo yishte vechometz lo yishte ella kach chometz yayin vechometz shechar lo yishte kelomar lo yishte yayin velo davar shennitarev bo hayyayin vehu hashshechar vaafillu hechmitzu vehoil velo kafal ella hachometz shehu shem echad eno loke al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo:

Nazir shehaya shote beyayin kol hayyom kullo af al pi shehu chayyav lashshamayim al kol reviit ureviit eno loke ella achat mishshum <small>(Bamidbar 6 4)</small> "yayin" veachat d <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "la yachel devaro" kemo shebbearnu. veim hitru bo al kol reviit ureviit veamru lo al tishte al tishte vehu shote chayyav al kol echad veechad. middivre sofrim sheasur lenazir laamod bemoshav shote yayin veyitrachek mimmennu harebe shehare michshol lefanav. amru chachamim saviv lakkerem lo yikrav:

Nazir sheggilleach seara achat loke ben betaar ben bezug vehu shekkitztzetza meikkarah keen taar. vechen im telashah beyado loke. echad hamegalleach veechad hammitgalleach shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 5)</small> "taar lo yaavor al rosho". veim hinniach mimmennu kede lachof roshah leikkarah eno loke sheen ze keen taar:
Heevir al rosho sam shemmashshir et hassear vehishshir et hassear eno loke ella bittel mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 5)</small> "gaddel pera sear rosho":
Nazir sheggilleach kol rosho eno loke mishshum hattiglachat ella achat. veim hitru bo al kol sear vesear veamru lo al tegalleach al tegalleach vehu megalleach loke al kol achat veachat:

Nazir chofef al searo beyado vechochech betzipparnav veim nafal sear eno choshesh shehare en kavvanato lehashshir veefshar shello yashshir. aval lo yisrok bemasrek velo yachof baadama mippene shemmashsheret et hassear vadday. veim asa chen eno loke:
Nazir shennitma lemet tumat shiva. ben betumot shehu megalleach alehen kemo sheyyitbaer ben betumot sheeno megalleach alehen. hare ze loke:
Nitma lemet peamim harebe af al pi shehu chayyav malkot al kol achat veachat lashshamayim en bet din malkin oto ella achat. veim hitru bo al kol paam ufaam vehu mittamme loke [al] kol achat veachat:

Bamme devarim amurim beshennitma uferash vechazar venaga o nasa o heehil. aval im haya nogea bemet vaadayin hammet beyado venaga bemet acher eno chayyav ella achat af al pi shehitru bo al kol negia unegia shehare mechullal veomed:

Nazir shennichnas levayit veshaha sham ad shemmet sham hammet. o shennichnas leohel hammet beshidda teva umigdal uva chavero ufara gag hatteva mealav middato. hare ze loke shetayim achat mishshum <small>(Bamidbar 6 6)</small> "lo yavo" veachat mishshum <small>(Bamidbar 6 7)</small> "lo yittamma". shehare tuma uvia bain keachat. aval im nichnas kedarko tumato kodemet leviato shemmeet sheyyachnis chatmo o etzbeot raglav nitma veeno chayyav mishshum bia ad sheyyavo kullo:

Nichnas leohel hammet o levet hakkevarot bishgaga. veachar shennoda lo hitru bo velo kafatz veyatza ella amad sham hare ze loke. vehu sheyyishhe sham kede hishtachavaya kemo tame shennichnas lammikdash:

Hametamme et hannazir. im haya hannazir mezid hannazir loke veze shettimmeo over mishshum <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl". veim haya hannazir shogeg veze shettimmeo mezid en echad mehem loke. velamma lo yilke hametamme et hannazir. lefi shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 9)</small> "vetimme et rosh nizro" eno loke ad sheyyetamme atzmo middato:

Nazir tahor shettimme atzmo loke af mishshum <small>(Devarim 23 22)</small> "lo teacher leshallemo". shehare icher nezirut tohora veasa maase. vechen im nadar bevet hakkevarot loke af mishshum lo teacher. ha lamadta shehannazir shettimme atzmo loke arba malkiyyot mishshum <small>(Bamidbar 6 7)</small> "lo yittamma" umishshum <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro" umishshum lo teacher leshallemo umishshum <small>(Bamidbar 6 6)</small> "lo yavo" im hayta bia vetuma keachat kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 6: Nazir sheshshata yayin veachal yotze min haggefen afillu yamim rabbim eno soter mime neziruto afillu yom echad. vechen im gilleach miut sear rosho ben beshogeg ben bemezid. nitgalleach rov rosho ben betaar ben keen taar velo nishar min hassearot kede lachof roshan leikkaran ben bezadon ben bishgaga afillu gillechuhu listim beones hare ze soter sheloshim yom ad sheyyihye lo pera veachar kach matchil limnot:

Ketzad. nadar nezirut mea yom uleachar esrim yom nitgalleach rov rosho hare ze shohe sheloshim yom ad sheyyirbe sear rosho. veachar hashsheloshim yom mone shemonim yom tashlum yeme neziruto. vechol otan hashsheloshim yom kol dikduke nezirut alav ella sheen olin lo min hamminyan:

Nazir shennitma ben bezadon ben bishgaga vaafillu timmeuhu akkum beones satar hakkol. umegalleach tiglachat tuma umevi karbenot tuma umatchil limnot yeme nezirut shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 12)</small> "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu". vaafillu nitma beyom melot yeme nizro besof hayyom satar hakkol:

Nitma achar yom melot, shehu yom havaat karbenot tohora illu lo nitma, soter sheloshim bilvad. vechetzad yaase. mevi karbenot tuma kesheyyithar umegalleach tiglachat tuma umatchil limnot nezirut sheloshim yom umegalleach tiglachat tohora umevi karbenot tohora. veim nitma achar shennizrak alav echad min haddamim eno soter kelum ella yavi shear karbenot tohora shello kesheyyithar:
Nitma bayyom shelleacharav shehu yom sherauy legaddel sear. illu gilleach achar melot hare ze eno soter kelum af al pi sheadayin lo gilleach shehare shalma hannezirut vechol shennitpal lah:

Nitma bayyom shennadar o bashsheni eno soter ella mashlim alehem achar sheyyavi karbano shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 12)</small> "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu" ad sheyyihyu sham shene yamim rishonim. lefichach im nitma mishshelishi vahala soter kol hakkodmin:

Nadar benazir vehu teme met chala alav nezirut. veim nitma paam acheret o shata yayin o gilleach loke. veim shaha betumato kamma yamim en olin lo ad sheyyazze shelishi ushevii veyitbol bashshevii veyom shevii shello ole lo mimminyan nezirut laze shennadar vehu tame. aval nazir tahor shennitma eno matchil limnot ella miyyom hashshemini vahala:

Mi shennadar vehu bevet hakkevarot nezirut chala alav vaafillu shaha sham kamma yamim en olin lo veloke al shehiyyato sham. veim hitru bo shello yazzir sham eno megalleach searo kesheyyetze mishsham. veim nitma sham bevet hakkevarot beachat min hattumot shehannazir megalleach alehen eno megalleach veeno mevi karban tuma:
Nichnas lesham beshidda teva umigdal uva chavero ufara alav et hammaaziva venitma af al pi sheshshaha sham eno loke. aval makkin oto makkat mardut im shaha:

Yatza mibbet hakkevarot veshaha yamim vechazar venichnas en otan hayyamim olin lo. yatza vehizza vetaval vetahar umana yamim minneziruto vechazar levet hakkevarot otan hayyamim shemmana olin lo. vaafillu nichnas beyom shemini shello hare hashshevii shello ole lo min hamminyan. veim nitma sham achar shennichnas beachat min hattumot shehannazir megalleach alehen mevi karban tuma vesoter hayyamim hakkodmin umegalleach tiglachat tuma:

Tiglachat tuma ketzad hi. hannazir shennitma beachat min hattumot shehu megalleach alehen hare ze mazze alav bashshelishi uvashshevii. umegalleach sear rosho bashshevii vetovel bashshevii achar hahazzaya kederech kol temee met. umaariv shimsho umevi karbenotav bashshemini vehen shete torim o shene bene yona echad leola veechad lechattat vecheves ben shenato leasham vesoter kol hayyamim hakkodmin umatchil limnot neziruto. veim gilleach bashshemini mevi karbenotav bo bayyom:
Meematay matchil limnot mishsheyyavi chattato. aval olato vaashamo en meakkevin oto millimnot:

Hare shehizza bashshelishi uvashshevii velo taval venitacher kamma yamim kesheyyitbol yaariv shimsho veyavi karbenotav lemachar. taval veheeriv shimsho veicher karbenotav eno matchil limnot ad sheyyavi chattato. aval olato vaashamo en meakkevin oto kemo shebbearnu:

Keshemmegalleach hannazir tiglachat tuma eno tzarich legalleach al petach hammikdash velo lehashelich searo al haesh. uven sheggilleach bammedina o bammikdash searo asur bahanaa vetaun kevura veefro asur keefer kol hannikbarim. vehamegalleach bammikdash im hishlichan tachat dud haasham yatza:

Nazir shennitma tumot harebe ben shehitru bo al kol achat veachat uven shello hitru bo al kol achat veachat eno mevi al tumotav ella karban echad. bamme devarim amurim shennitma paam sheniyya kodem sheyyavi karbenot tuma harishona veaf al pi shennitacher kamma yamim achar tohorato kodem havaat chattato venitma beotan hayyamim eno mevi ella karban echad. aval im nitma vetahar vehevi chattato venitma paam sheniyya achar shehevi chattato af al pi sheadayin lo hevi ashamo veolato chayyav bekarbanot acherot:

Nazir sheggilleach tiglachat tohora veachar kach noda shettame haya betoch yeme nizro. im betuma yedua nitma satar hakkol. umevi karbenot tuma umegalleach tiglachat tuma umone nezirut acheret umevi karbenot tohora. veim betumat hattehom nitma eno soter. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala:

Veim ad shello nizrak alav echad min haddamim noda shehu tame. ben betuma yedua ben betumat hattehom soter hakkol. noda lo achar shennizrak echad min haddamim af al pi shello gilleach hoil vetuma sheenah yedua hi eno soter:
E zo hi tumat hattehom. kol sheen adam makkirah afillu besof haolam. velo amru tumat hattehom ella lemet bilvad aval harug lo shehare yodea bo ze sheharago:

Nimtza hammet galuy en ze tumat hattehom. nimtza mushka bekarkait meara vehammayim al gabbav hare ze tumat hattehom sheenah yedua. haya tamun beteven o bitzrorot hare zo tumat hattehom. bemayim baafela uvinkike hasselaim enah tumat hattehom:

Nazir shennitma bemet veyarad vetaval bammeara vehevi karbenot tuma umana nezirut vegilleach tiglachat tohora veachar kach noda shemmet haya mushka bekarkait hammeara kesheyyarad litbol af al pi shehi tuma sheenah yedua satar hakkol. mippene shehuchzak letuma vechezkat hattame tame ad sheyyithar vadday. yarad lehaker hare ze tahor ad sheyyeda shennaga. nimtza hammet tzaf al pene hammayim hare ze bechezkat tame. shechezkato shennaga baze shehu tzaf:
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 7:
Yesh tumot min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach alehen velo soter et hakkodmin veaf al pi shennitma bahen tumat shiva. lefi shello neemar bo vechi yittamma lenefesh ella <small>(Bamidbar 6 9)</small> "vechi yamut met alav" ad sheyyittame mittumot shehen meatzmo shel met veachar kach yavi karbenot tuma vigalleach tiglachat tuma veyippelu kol hayyamim harishonim: 
Veellu tumot min hammet shehannazir megalleach alehen. al hannefel vaafillu lo nitkashsheru evarav begidin. veal kezayit mibbesar hammet. veal kezayit netzel. veal atzamot shehen rov minyan haatzamot af al pi sheen bahen rova hakkav. veal atzamot shehen rov binyano shel met veaf al pi sheen bahen rova hakkav. veal chatzi kav atzamot af al pi sheen bahen lo rov binyano velo rov minyano. vechol haatzamot yihyu mishshel met echad velo mishshene metim. veal hashshidra habbaa mimmet echad. veal haggulgolet shel met echad. veal evar min hammet habba mimmet echad. veal evar min hachay meadam echad. sheyyesh alehen basar sherauy laalot bo arucha bechay. veal chatzi log dam habba mimmet echad. veal melo chafnayim rekev hammet. e zehu netzel ze besar hammet shennimmoach venaasa lecha serucha: 
Veen rekev hammet metamme ad sheyyikkaver erom bearon shel shayish veyihye kullo shalem. chaser mimmennu evar o shennikbar bichsuto o bearon shel etz o beshel mattechet en lo rekev. velo amru rekev ella lemet bilvad lehotzi harug shehare chaser damo: 
Kavru shene metim keechad. o sheggazzu searo o tzipparnav ukevarum immo. o ishsha ubbara shemmeta venikbera veubbarah bemeeha en harekev shellahem metamme. vechen im tachan hammet ad shennaasa rekev eno metamme ad sheyyarkiv meelav. tachan et hammet vehinniach afaro ad shehirkiv kullo. o [shehirkiv] miktzato keshehu chay umet vehirkiv hakkol hare ze safek veim nitma lerekev ze hare ze sefek tame. vechen im nitma berova atzamot habbain mehashshidra o min haggulgolet beoholan hare ze sefek tame: 
Kol ellu hashshetem esre tumot shemmaninu im naga nazir beachat mehen o nesaah o heehil hannazir aleha o heehil hattuma al hannazir o haya hannazir veachat mittumot ellu beohel echad hare ze megalleach tiglachat tuma umevi karban tuma vesoter et hakkol. chutz min harekev sheeno metamme bemagga shei efshar sheyyigga bechullo shehare eno guf echad. aval im nesao o nitma beoholo megalleach: 
Vechen nazir shennaga beetzem hammet afillu etzem kisora o nesao hare ze megalleach alav umevi karbenot tuma vesoter et hakkodmim. veen etzem kisora metamme beohel. aval nitma beachat mishshenem asar devarim hallalu. begush eretz haakkum o besade shennechrash kever betochah shehen metammein bemagga uvemassa. o sheheehil alav veal hassarigim hayyotzim min hailanot o happeraot hayyotzot min haggader o mitta o gamal vechayyotze bo. o shennitma beohel rova atzamot sheen bahen lo rov binyan velo rov minyan. o shennitma birviit dam min hammet shehi metamme bemagga uvemassa uveohel. o shennitma begolel o bedofek shehen metammein bemagga uveohel. o shennitma beevar min hachay o beevar min hammet sheen alehen basar karauy. hare ze eno soter: 
Af al pi shebbechol ellu hu tame tumat shiva umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii. eno megalleach tiglachat tuma velo mevi karbanot velo soter et hakkodmin. aval kol yeme hattuma en olin lo mimminyan yeme neziruto: 
Naga beohel hammet o bechelim hannogim bemet eno mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii. veyerae li sheddin ze meyuchad benazir. aval kol adam shennitma bichli tumat shiva yazze bashshelishi uvashshevii kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot tumat met. vechen yerae li shezze sheeno mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii im naga bechelim kede sheyyaalu lo yeme tumato bechelim mimminyan yeme neziruto: 
Nazir shennitztarea vehuchlat kol yeme chilluto veshivat yeme sefiro shessofer achar sheyyithar letzarato ben tiglachat rishona lishniyya en olin lo mime neziruto. aval yeme hesger olin lo. vechen im zav besaro ben ish ben ishsha kol yeme zivatan olin lahen af al pi shehen temein. vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay hu: 
En tzarich lomar sheim nitma hannazir bishar tumot sheyyeme tumato olin lo veeno soter kelum. nitma bemet betoch yeme tzarato soter et kol hakkodmin shehare binziruto omed veaf al pi shehu tame: 
Hannazir muttar betumat met mitzva uvetiglachat mitzva. veasur beyen hammitzva keyen harshut. ketzad. mi shennishba sheyyishte hayyom yayin shehare mitzva alav lishtot veachar kach nadar benazir chala nezirut al hashshevua veasur beyayin. veen tzarich lomar shehu asur beyen kiddush vehavedala sheeno ella middivre sofrim: 
Vechetzad hu muttar betumat met mitzva. haya mehallech badderech ufaga bemet sheen sham mi sheyyikberennu hare ze mittamme lo vekovro. udevarim ellu divre kabbala hen: 
Nazir vechohen sheppagu bemet mitzva yittamme nazir af al pi shehu soter hayyamim harishonim umevi karban tuma. veal yittamme kohen. shezze kedushshato kedushshat shaa vaafillu haya nezir olam. vehakkohen kedushshato kedushshat olam: 
Pagu bo shene nezirim echad nazir sheloshim yom veechad nazir mea yom yittamme nezir sheloshim. haya echad nazir lizman katzuv vehashsheni nezir olam yittamme hannazir lizman katzuv. shennezirut olam kedushshato chamura mizze: 
Vechetzad hu muttar betiglachat mitzva. nazir shennitztarea venirpa mitztzarato betoch yeme nezirut hare ze megalleach kol searo shehare tiglachto mitzvat ase shenneemar bimtzora <small>(Vayikra 14 8)</small> "vegillach et kol searo" vegomer. vechol makom sheatta motze mitzvat ase velo taase im yachol atta lekayyem et shenehem mutav veim lav yavo ase veyidche et lo taase. vahalo nazir sheggilleach bime nizro avar al lo taase vaase shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 5)</small> "kadsh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho" uvechol makom en ase docha lo taase vaase velamma doche ase shel tiglachat hannega linzirut. mippene shekkevar nitma hannazir betzaraat vime chilluto en olin lo kemo shebbearnu. vahare eno kadosh bahen. uvatal haase meelav velo nishar ella lo taase shehu <small>(Bamidbar 6 5)</small> "taar lo yaavor al rosho". ulefichach ba ase shel tiglachat hatztzaraat vedacha oto:
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 8:
Tiglachat hattohora ketzad hi. kesheyyigmor hannazir yeme neziruto mevi shalosh behemot keves leola vechavsa lechattat veayil lishlamim. hevi shelashtan velo peresh. haruya lechattat tikrav chattat veharuya lishlamim shelamim veharuya leola ola. umevi im el hashshelamim shishsha esronot ushene shelishe issaron solet. ofe mehen esrim challa eser challot matztzot vaasara rekike matztzot. umosheach haesrim birviit shemen. veshiur ze halacha lemoshe missinay. umevi haesrim bichli echad: 
Veshochet hachattat techilla veachar kach haola veachar kach shelamim veachar kach megalleach. veim gilleach achar sheshshachat hachattat o haola yatza. umevashshel hashshelamim o sholkan velokeach min harotev shel zivche hashshelamim venoten al hassear veachar kach mashlicho laesh tachat dud hashshelamim. veim hishlicho tachat hachattat yatza: 
Vehechan megalleach searo beezrat hannashim belishkat hannezirim shehayta sham bekeren mizrachit deromit veshem mevashshelin et shelamehen umashlichin searan laesh. veim gilleach bammedina yatza. uven sheggilleach bammedina uven sheggilleach bammikdash tachat haddud hu mashlich searo. veeno megalleach ad sheyyihye petach haazara patuach shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 18)</small> "petach ohel moed". lo sheyyegallach keneged happetach shezze bizyon mikdash hu: 
Veachar kach notel hakkohen et hazzeroa beshela min haayil vechallat matztza achat min hassal verakik echad venotnan al kappe hannazir o hannezira umenifan veachar kach huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ulehittamme lemetim:
